acceptanceCriteria: Opt-in policy `loopDetection {maxNoProgressGenerations, maxAlternatingReturns}` (default off). Evaluated purely from audited attempt history at the current acceptance revision. Counted signals: consecutive clean hand-offs with an unchanged candidate tree, no gate results and no external-review change; and alternating implement/REVIEW_RETURNED pairs.

Above the threshold, eligibility, claim, claim-next, plan and dispatch status show a derived `LOOP_DETECTED` hold with the counted generations as evidence. Ticket status is not rewritten (same shape as ESC-V0-006).

The hold clears on an acceptance-revision change or an explicit operator acknowledgement through the existing writer. The dispatcher raises a typed #502 `blocked` escalation when it first observes the hold, once per episode.
Missing history is UNKNOWN and never counts toward the threshold.
body: Filed 2026-10-05 from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#587 (orchestrator triage T587b, read-only code survey on origin/main 019f958a; findings are code-read inferences, not runtime). - Type FEATURE, **P2**: depends on #502 hold machinery (PR #582), and the dispatcher already parks after `parkAfter`. - Labels: `agent-memory`, `ideas`, `github587` - touchPaths: `.corvint/change.cem.json`, `.corvint/changes/`, `docs/specs/INDEX.json`, `docs/specs/README.md`, `docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv`, `docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md`, `docs/specs/corvint-tasks-escalations-v0.md`, `internal/tasks/dispatch/loop.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/loop_detect.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/loop_detect_test.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/plan.go`, `internal/tasks/wire/codes.go` - Acceptance: 1. Opt-in policy `loopDetection {maxNoProgressGenerations, maxAlternatingReturns}` (default off). Evaluated purely from audited attempt history at the current acceptance revision. Counted signals: consecutive clean hand-offs with an unchanged candidate tree, no gate results and no external-review change; and alternating implement/REVIEW_RETURNED pairs. 2. Above the threshold, eligibility, claim, claim-next, plan and dispatch status show a derived `LOOP_DETECTED` hold with the counted generations as evidence. Ticket status is not rewritten (same shape as ESC-V0-006). 3. The hold clears on an acceptance-revision change or an explicit operator acknowledgement through the existing writer. The dispatcher raises a typed #502 `blocked` escalation when it first observes the hold, once per episode. 4. Missing history is UNKNOWN and never counts toward the threshold. - Depends on: V1-0699 / PR #582 merged; T587a (better progress signal).

completion.reason: Every acceptance criterion is met: opt-in loopDetection policy with byte-identical canonical policy when absent, LOOP_DETECTED derived hold from audited attempt history (CAL-V0-102..103) surfaced in eligibility, claim, plan, show and blockers, one dispatcher needs-owner event per episode, and ticket reopen as the only acknowledgement (owner decision).
